canonical_title: Google launches Gemini Enterprise for Legal and Financial Services
treatment: Treat the initial industry-specific Gemini Enterprise launch as covered. Reinclude only for general availability, material pricing/API changes, major named-customer production deployment, benchmarked workflow results, security/governance changes, or expansion into a materially new industry vertical.
known_facts: Google Cloud launched Gemini Enterprise for Legal and Gemini Enterprise for Financial Services on 2026-08-25 as the first packaged industry solutions on Gemini Enterprise.
The Legal offering is initially available in preview and combines specialized legal skills, secure connectors, partner agents and governance controls.
Legal integrations include platforms from Thomson Reuters, Harvey, iManage, NetDocuments, Relativity and others, including MCP-based connections.
Launch collaborators include Cleary Gottlieb, Freshfields, Weil and Williams & Connolly.

The Financial Services offering is initially available in preview for capital markets and corporate banking, with a Google-managed Financial Research agent and more than 50 specialized skills; CME Group and Deutsche Bank are among named users/design partners.
reinclude_only_if: Google announces general availability or material pricing/API changes.
A major named customer discloses production-scale deployment or measurable workflow results.
Google publishes material model, security, governance or benchmark details specific to the industry suites.
Gemini Enterprise expands into another industry with materially distinct product capabilities.
notes: NEW in the 2026-08-25 Night window. Legal and Financial Services were grouped as one industry-suite launch event to avoid duplicate reporting of a coordinated same-day product rollout.
